title: Concept: XML resolver left enabled on a document parser in csharp — review required
description: In csharp, an XML resolver is attached to the parser. Entity expansion then reaches URLs and file paths the author never intended, which is the XXE primitive: local file disclosure, internal port scanning and denial of service through entity expansion. The assignment is usually copied from an older sample.
applicability: csharp services that parse XML from clients or partners.
risk: Local file disclosure and SSRF during parsing; HIGH severity.
